label: Diagram 3.2
caption: Diagram 3.2 Flat where all habitable rooms have direct access to an entrance hall
description: This is a floor plan, with its caption "Diagram 3.2 Flat where all habitable rooms have direct access to an entrance hall" shown in a green banner along the bottom. A note at the top left reads "See para 3.18a". A horizontal band runs across the middle of the plan; this is the entrance hall, bounded by thick green lines and dimensioned "9m max." by a double-headed arrow along its length, with the left, entrance end shaded grey (the protected entrance hall). That left end is marked "Flat entrance" with a door-swing arc. Rooms open onto the hall through doors labelled "Fd", each drawn with a swing arc: two on the upper side, four on the lower side, and one at the right end. The left external wall is a thick black line. A legend on the right defines the green line as "Fire resisting construction (minimum REI 0)", "Fd" as "Fire doorset (minimum E 20)", the grey square as "Protected entrance hall (minimum REI 30)", and the black line as "See Appendix B for compartment walls separating a flat from any other part of the building or other occupancies". A NOTE adds that bathrooms do not need fire doorsets provided the bathroom is separated by fire resisting construction from the adjacent rooms.
